# FDO-side SDK notice authorization

On 2026-11-19, the repository maintainer stated in this implementation session:

> I control SDK rights but please do that on FDO side

When asked for the copyright holder to use in an FDO-side ISC notice for the
installed SDK, the maintainer confirmed:

> Oleksandr Nykytenko (AleXvWaN)

FDO therefore retains `third_party/licenses/fdo-sdk-1.9.2-ISC.txt` for
`@anikitenko/fdo-sdk@1.9.2`, whose installed package declares ISC. No copyright
year was supplied or inferred. This is a maintainer-authorized FDO-side notice,
not a recovered upstream license file or a statement about other contributors'
rights. It does not clear `lazy-val`, other versions, or the separate publication
rights review. The SDK repository/package was not changed.
